comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the org-dependent `x-codemie-client` value has no config-level override — the Concern (b) mitigation references a surface that does not exist**

The PR itself flags that `flutter-agent-harness` (the hardcoded `codeMieClient` constant, `lib/src/providers/codemie_sso.dart:43`) may be an unregistered client id on some CodeMie gateways, and offers two mitigations in the PR description: (a) change the constant, or (b) "per deployment, set `x-codemie-client` on the saved custom-provider entry's headers — an explicit user entry already wins the merge".

Mitigation (b) is not reachable: **`CustomProviderEntry` has no `headers` field** (`lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart:58-78`; `CustomProviderEntry.fromYaml` parses only `name/apiType/baseUrl/modelId/keyName/authMethod/authHeader/connectTimeoutMs/streamIdleTimeoutMs/keyNotPersisted/project` and silently ignores everything else), and neither roles `ModelRef` nor the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` preconfig nor the Flutter app connection carries a headers map. The tested override (INV-2) exists only at the programmatic adapter level (`Model.headers` / `OpenAICompletionsOptions.headers`), which CLI and app users cannot reach from config.

So if a gateway attributes budgets only to registered client ids, a CLI/app deployment cannot adapt to its org's expected value without a code change — the exact contingency the PR description rates plausible ("may not work until resolved"). Precedent: `x-codemie-project` (issue #1809) got a real per-entry config surface (`entry.project`) for exactly this kind of per-org data.

**Fix options (any one resolves this):**
1. Add a `headers:` map to `CustomProviderEntry` yaml + flow it into `buildCatalogModel`/`buildCliDefaultModel` (largest, most general); or
2. An env override (e.g. `CODEMIE_CLIENT_ID`) folded into `codeMieRequestHeaders` resolution (smallest); or
3. Docs-only: correct the PR Concern (b) and the `docs/agents/providers.md:42` "explicit user entry of the same name wins the merge" claim to state the value is compile-time-fixed and per-org changes require a rebuild.

Option 3 alone is acceptable if the CodeMie team confirms any client string is attributed as-is (please note the answer in the thread).

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
# Fix: config-level override for `x-codemie-client` — implemented (fix option 2 + the option-3 docs correction)

Adopted **fix option 2** (the smallest): a `CODEMIE_CLIENT_ID` env override folded into the `codeMieRequestHeaders` resolution — plus the option-3 docs correction of the unreachable "explicit user entry of the same name wins the merge" claim you flagged.

## What changed

- **`lib/src/providers/codemie_sso.dart`** — new deployment seam, following the existing `providerFilterEnvOverride` pattern (lib/ stays `dart:io`-free):
  - `codeMieClientOverride` — resolved once at host startup; null keeps the `flutter-agent-harness` constant.
  - `resolveCodeMieClientOverride(env)` — folds `CODEMIE_CLIENT_ID` out of an env map; trimmed, blank-safe (a blank value must never blank the header — that would lose budget attribution entirely, the bug #2426 fixes).
  - `codeMieRequestHeaders` is now a getter resolving `codeMieClientOverride ?? codeMieClient`; every existing spread call site (chat defaults slot, fetch twins, quota, catalog/SSO builds, app `toModel()`) picks it up unchanged.
- **`bin/fah.dart` / `bin/fah_runapp.dart`** — CLI startup folds `Platform.environment` into the override (`_applyCodeMieClientEnv`, next to `_applyProviderFilterEnv`).
- **`flutter_app/lib/boot/app_boot.dart`** — `bootServices()` folds `CODEMIE_CLIENT_ID` from the app `.env` (same mechanism as the app's `FA_PROVIDERS` override), before any connection restore, so `AgentConfig.toModel()` bakes the overridden value.
- **`docs/agents/providers.md:42`** — the Client contract no longer implies a saved-entry headers surface (there is none, as you showed): it now names the reachable surfaces — `CODEMIE_CLIENT_ID` (CLI process env / app `.env`) for per-org adaptation, and the adapter-API `Model.headers`/`options` entry for the merge-wins behavior.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — the gh-2426 entry documents the override.

## Tests (TDD, red → green)

- `test/providers/codemie_sso_test.dart` — resolution semantics (trimmed value, absent → null, blank → null, unrelated keys ignored), getter resolution + reset, and the override riding the `/models` fetch.
- `test/providers/openai_completions_project_test.dart` — wire-level: with only the env seam set (model carries no headers), the chat request sends `x-codemie-client: my-org-client`.
- `test/model_roles/model_resolver_test.dart` — the override bakes into `buildCatalogModel` + `buildCliDefaultModel` builds; non-CodeMie builds stay header-less (INV-3).
- `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart` — `bootServices()` resolves the override without plugin channels (null under the test runner, mirroring the `providerFilterEnvOverride` degrade test).

A CLI/app deployment whose gateway attributes budgets to a different registered client id can now adapt via `CODEMIE_CLIENT_ID=...` with no code change. The gateway-side registration question (whether `flutter-agent-harness` itself must be registered) stays open with the CodeMie team — the override makes it a deployment concern either way.

comments.body:
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The `x-codemie-client` wiring is systematic and well-tested (chat defaults slot, catalog/SSO/boot builds, fetch twins, quota, app `toModel()`; 130 SDK + 2 app tests pass locally, CI green at review time). One ⚠️ issue gates approval: the org-dependent client value has no config-level override — the PR description's Concern (b) mitigation references a `headers` field that `CustomProviderEntry` does not have.

**Key Issues**:
- ⚠️ `docs/agents/providers.md:42` — the "explicit user entry of the same name wins the merge" override is adapter-API-only: no CLI/app config surface (saved entry, roles `ModelRef`, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, app connection) can produce such an entry, so a gateway expecting a different registered client id cannot be configured without a code change (evidence: `lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart:58-78`).

**Digest (non-blocking 🪶)**:
- `lib/src/providers/codemie_sso.dart:38` — merge is case-sensitive by map key: a mixed-case `X-CodeMie-Client` user header rides as a SECOND header instead of overriding (documented E5; server behavior for duplicate values is undefined).
- `flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service_connection_guard.dart:10` — `isCodeMieProvider` is case-sensitive `contains` vs the adapter's case-insensitive `isCodeMieBaseUrl`; odd-cased URLs skip the app-baked headers but the adapter still adds the header on the wire (pre-existing helper, no wire gap).

**Next Steps**:
1. Add a config-level override for `x-codemie-client` (entry-level `headers:` or an env var), or correct the Concern (b) / providers.md claim to state the value is compile-time-fixed.
2. Confirm with the CodeMie team whether `flutter-agent-harness` needs gateway-side registration; note the answer in the thread.
